<!-- 升级版标签云 -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const linksDiv = document.querySelector('.about-links');
  if (!linksDiv) return;

  // 关键词 & 出现次数（可改为动态）
  const tags = [
    {name: 'higher category theory', count: 0},
    {name: 'operator algebras',        count: 0},
    {name: 'derived algebraic geometry', count: 0},
    {name: 'extended TQFT',          count: 0},
    {name: 'mathematical physics',     count: 0},
    {name: 'TQFT',                   count: 0}
  ];

  // 生成渐变色系
  const gradList = [
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#d9a441,#f3d97a)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#00529b,#2a75c2)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#3399ff,#66b3ff)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#66b3ff,#99ccff)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#99ccff,#c2e0ff)',
    'linear-gradient(135deg,#7b68ee,#9370db)'
  ];

  let html = '<div class="tag-cloud-sidebar">';
  tags.forEach((t,i) => {
    const grad = gradList[i % gradList.length];
    html += `
      <a class="tag" href="#research" style="background:${grad};">
        ${t.name}
        <span class="count">${t.count}</span>
      </a>`;
  });
  html += '</div>';
  linksDiv.insertAdjacentHTML('afterend', html);
});
</script>
